# Population Cleaning Script

## Import Raw Data

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

load_dotenv()
```

```{python}
data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
txt_path = data_dir / "population" / "us.1990_2024.20ages.adjusted.txt"
```

```{python}
df_raw = pd.read_fwf(txt_path, header = None, names=['FIPS_info', 'other_info'])
```

## Separate Into Readable Columns

### Year

```{python}
df_raw['year'] = df_raw['FIPS_info'].str[:4].astype(int)
```

```{python}
# remove years outside of analysis window
df_raw = df_raw[df_raw['year'] > 2000]
df_raw = df_raw[df_raw['year'] < 2023]
```

### FIPS

```{python}
df_raw['county_id'] = df_raw['FIPS_info'].str[-5:]
```

### Population

```{python}
df_raw['population'] = df_raw['other_info'].astype(str).str[-8:].astype(int)
```

## Deal with combined city-counties

```{python}
# Assigned combined Bedford county VA and Bedford city to Bedford county id
df_raw.loc[df_raw["county_id"] == "51917", "county_id"] = "51019"

# remapping Oglala Lakota County code to fips standard
df_raw.loc[df_raw["county_id"] == "46113", "county_id"] = "46102"
```


## Sum By Column

```{python}
df_final = df_raw.groupby(['year', 'county_id'], as_index = False)['population'].sum()
```


## EDA

### Summary Statistics
```{python}
df_final.describe()
```

### Example Plot

#### Average Population Over Time
```{python}
sns.lineplot(df_final, x='year', y='population')

plt.title("Average Population by County Over Time")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Population")

plt.yticks(rotation=45)

plt.show()
```

# Export to database

```{python}
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
df_final.to_sql(
    "population",
    con=engine,
    if_exists="replace",
    index=False
)
```
